s: 3 weeks ago - The original Wonder Man costume was a red and green ensemble designed by artist Don Heck, and made its debut in 1964’s Avengers #9. It was very short-lived, as poor Simon Williams died in that very issue. But Marvel revived the character about a decade later, and he became an Avenger in earnest from there on out.
